title: run-workflow's worker path still pushes per-tick branches with no attempt identity
body: us2 moved the EPIC reconciler's sandbox attempts to per-attempt landing branches and the attempt's own write_ref, but run-workflow.ts's standalone-run worker dispatch still boots containers with the plain epic slot, landing pushes on tick/<epic>/<tick>. That flow has no attempt numbers, so it may be fine — but nobody has stated why, and it is the same review theme one surface over.
